info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Gateway Transaction Update API
info.description: The Financial Gateway Transaction Update API enables businesses to modify existing payment transactions within the financial gateway. Using this API, users can update transaction details, allowing for adjustments to payment statuses, amounts, or associated metadata. This service is crucial for financial institutions, payment processors, and other entities that require real-time transaction management. Common use cases include handling customer request for transaction adjustments or rectifying errors in payment submissions.
